text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hm-hmm! ♪ I've got me some training today! …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: We're about to throw a party. You can join in if you'd like, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course, I—I would… if didn't I have training today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Oh… And we even ordered in an extra-large pizza, too. Welp, if you can't make it, that's fine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But… it's not like my training starts right this second. I think I can slot this in…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're okay on time?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no problem! C'mon, let's get this party started!
